'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Queen of Denmark|Queen]] [[Margrethe II]] [[COVID-19 testing|tests]] positive for [[COVID-19]], with mild [[COVID-19 symptoms|symptoms]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/queen-of-denmark-queen-margrethe-ii-tests-positive-for-covid-2759280 (NDTV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Prime Minister of Slovenia|Slovenian Prime Minister]] [[Janez Janša]] tests positive for COVID-19, with mild symptoms. [https://www.barrons.com/news/slovenian-pm-jansa-tests-positive-for-covid-19-01644403806 (''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[King of Spain|King]] [[Felipe VI]] tests positive for COVID-19, with mild symptoms. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/spains-king-felipe-tests-positive-covid-19-2022-02-09/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****Sweden scraps almost all pandemic restrictions, essentially declaring the pandemic as "over". The move is condemned by scientists in Sweden and abroad, who warn the pandemic still persists and continues to represent serious dangers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/sweden-declare-pandemic-over-despite-warnings-scientists-2022-02-09/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
***[[Hong Kong]] reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 1,161 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the territory-wide total of confirmed cases to 17,808. Hong Kong also reports their first two deaths from COVID-19 since September. [https://amp.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3166328/coronavirus-hong-kong-new-cases-expected-top-1100 (''South China Morning Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Johnson & Johnson]] officially suspends production of its [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine|COVID-19 vaccine]]. It says production will likely resume later, and that millions of doses remain stocked for distribution per earlier agreements. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/johnson-and-johnson-covid-19-vaccine-production-halt/ (CBS News)]
